Draconic Illusionist Action - Invocation (Uprising). 'Transform target ash you control into Yendurai. Go again'.

GO_AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it would be a defect.

TARGET NOTE: Same as invoke_kyloria_red — 'target ash you control' is a declared target but TRANSFORM's internal scan of player.permanents handles selection, matching the shipped invoke_nekria_red shape.

TRANSFORM HANDLER: from='ash' matches any card with Ash subtypes. up_to=false: CR 8.5.36d makes it mandatory — no Ash in play means the play cannot happen. 'into Yendurai' → to='yendurai' triggers _do_transform which calls create_token('yendurai') then _ek_transform to put sources under the new permanent.

GAP: yendurai token has no JSON definition in json/tokens/ yet. create_token will raise MissingCardImplementation at resolution until the token file is promoted.
